findings.title: Missing description and technical specifications
findings.message: Both short and long texts are empty, providing no information about the required work, materials, dimensions or standards, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which demands clear and exhaustive descriptions.
findings.suggestion: Add a detailed short and long text specifying the work scope, required materials, dimensions, applicable norms (e.g., DIN 18331) and performance criteria.

findings.suggestion: Provide a clear short text and a detailed long text with all required technical data (material, size, norm).

findings.title: Unclear unit and ambiguous reference to "Hinweis für Rohrhalterungen"
findings.message: The unit is "St" (piece) but the text refers to weight loads per linear meter, creating a mismatch between unit and described requirement.
findings.suggestion: Clarify whether the position is for a piece of pipe holder or for a calculation of load capacity per meter; adjust unit accordingly.

findings.title: Missing mandatory technical data for surveying services
findings.message: The description lacks required details such as reference to the applicable VOB/C ATV for surveying (ATV 710), required accuracy verification, and the exact deliverables (e.g., GIS‑compatible formats).
findings.suggestion: Add the mandatory specifications: reference to ATV 710, required accuracy, deliverable formats, and any necessary approvals.

findings.title: Missing description for pipe length
findings.message: Both short and long texts are empty, providing no information about pipe type, material, diameter, or standards, which is required under VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Insert a clear short text and a detailed long text specifying pipe material, nominal diameter, pressure class, and applicable norms (e.g., DIN EN 10220).

findings.title: Unclear wording and missing technical specifications for hourly work
findings.message: The long text contains repetitive, vague statements and does not define the scope of the hourly work, the applicable tariff, or the inclusion of surcharges, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Provide a precise description of the hourly work, reference the exact tariff (e.g., VOB/B Tarif), and list included surcharges.

findings.title: Missing clear definition of device rental rates
findings.message: The long text repeats a generic statement without specifying which devices, rates, or included costs, leading to ambiguity under VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: List each device, its hourly rate, and all included costs (fuel, operator, wear).

findings.title: Redundant "Material" entry without specification
findings.message: The long text only contains the word "Material" without any details, which does not meet the requirement for a clear description.
findings.suggestion: Specify the material type, quantity, and any relevant standards.
